breakeven_cost_bps.note: round-trip cost at which a variant's mean return reaches zero

mechanism: ARTEFACT, NOT SIGNAL. Gross returns are negative, but shuffled data with no structure at all produces -0.02 residual Sharpe against an observed -0.19 (z = -1.194). The negative result is a property of the measurement, not of the market. Claim nothing from it.

null_calibration.note: Null datasets reuse the real bar returns in random order: same distribution, no serial structure. If the observed value sits inside this spread it is an artefact of the measurement, not a property of the market.
